drinks.title: Drinks
drinks.subtitle: House classics. Seasonal pleasures. Your next favorite.

items.name: Devine Old Fashioned
items.description: A moody, sophisticated twist on a timeless classic. Deep rye spice weaves through a velvety red wine reduction for a rich, lingering, slow-sipping finish.

items.name: Spiced Blood Orange Old Fashioned
items.description: Warm, cozy, and wonderfully complex in every single sip. Rich bourbon meets dark blood orange, rounded out by comforting brown sugar and baking spices.

items.name: Bourbon Bramble
items.description: A beautiful collision of dark, jammy blackberry and smooth, oaky warmth. Brightened by a touch of citrus, it creates a remarkably refreshing, grounded pour.

items.name: Devine Margarita
items.description: The absolute purest expression of a beloved bar classic. Clean, bright tequila is perfectly balanced with fresh citrus for a flawlessly smooth, refreshing finish.

items.name: Blackberry Pineapple Margarita
items.description: The ultimate summer throwback making a highly requested, vibrant return. Rich, bold blackberry and bright, sun-drenched pineapple collide to deliver pure, breezy tropical refreshment.

items.name: Aperol Spritz
items.description: The quintessential sunset sipper for a warm Texas evening. It is bright, beautifully bubbly, and kissed with a refreshing, bittersweet orange glow.

items.name: Hugo Spritz
items.description: A crisp, garden-fresh breeze perfectly captured in a glass. Delicate elderflower notes dance with lively champagne bubbles and a remarkably bright snap of lime.

items.name: Valvet Espresso Martini
items.description: Rich, creamy, and undeniably indulgent from the very first sip. A smooth, caffeinated kick is wrapped in a luxurious, completely silky texture.

items.name: Devine Drop
items.description: Like pure sunshine served beautifully in a chilled glass. This vibrant, intensely crisp burst of double-citrus finishes with a perfectly sweet and tart bite.

items.name: French Martini
items.description: Playful, lush, and undeniably sophisticated from start to finish. This velvety, tropical escape is beautifully elevated by a rich, sweet ribbon of dark raspberry.

sections.title: Fall Special · Bar Only
sections.note: Tuesday–Friday 3–6 PM | Saturday 4–7 PM. Bar only. 20% off appetizers.

items.name: Martinis
items.description: A rotating showcase of the ultimate cocktail hour icon. Let our bartenders craft a perfectly chilled, flawlessly balanced pour tailored exactly to the moment.

items.name: Old Fashioned
items.description: The timeless standard is constantly reimagined with a rotating selection. Experience a complex, grounded, slow-sipping classic crafted uniquely every time.

items.name: Devine Infusion Tini
items.description: A constantly evolving, bartender-curated creation born from our house-infused spirits. Expect bold, unexpected, and completely unique flavor profiles that change with our creative inspiration.

items.name: Apple Cider Margarita
items.description: The crisp, nostalgic essence of autumn orchard days meets the bright agave warmth of a classic margarita. A perfectly balanced, spiced, and refreshing seasonal pour.

items.name: Pumpkin Spice White Russian
items.description: This undeniably indulgent and wonderfully creamy classic wraps you in a completely luxurious texture. Familiar baking spices provide the ultimate cozy autumn escape.

items.name: Salted Caramel Mocha Martini
items.description: A caffeinated rush meets decadent chocolate and a beautiful touch of sea salt. This perfectly balanced dessert pour is remarkably smooth and indulgent.

items.name: Pear & Elderflower Spritz
items.description: Delicate, fragrant pear and bright elderflower blossoms dance beautifully with crisp champagne bubbles. This exquisitely light and fresh breeze perfectly captures a crisp autumn afternoon.

items.name: Autumn Bourbon Sour
items.description: Deep, oaky bourbon wraps around a brilliantly tart citrus core for a remarkably cozy evening sipper. Subtle fall spices create a profoundly rich, lingering finish.

items.name: Pomegranate Cosmo
items.description: A sophisticated, vibrant twist on a modern classic that delivers an incredibly bright, tart snap. Deep crimson fruit notes offer a flawlessly smooth, elegant finish.
